title: Sample admission trace closure consistently with concurrent span updates
outcome: The terminal trace boundary and per-phase aggregates stay internally consistent when a worker starts or finishes a span while the collector closes.
acceptance: Closing a trace samples or clamps timestamps under an ordering that prevents a span endpoint or start from exceeding the terminal boundary and prevents one late active span from subtracting another active span's elapsed time.
A deterministic concurrency witness covers span creation and completion racing with closure, while confirming late workers cannot change the closed image.
